title: The Midnight Library Mystery
tagline: A priceless atlas vanished during Family Game Night. Solve each problem to earn a clue.
inputHint: Type a number like -4, or an expression like 3x+5. Use ^ for exponents, like x^2.
intro: It was Family Game Night at the Westbrook Public Library when the lights flickered. When they came back on, the glass case in the lobby was empty: The Map of Everything, a 200-year-old atlas, was gone!

Six people were in the building, each seen in a different room, and there are six sneaky ways to smuggle out a giant book. You are the lead detective. Find out who took it, where they were, and how they got it away.
rules: Solve each problem correctly to unlock a clue. A wrong answer just means try again; hints appear if you get stuck.
Every clue rules out something on the case board: a suspect and the place they were seen, or a method.
The thief acted alone in a spot nobody else was in, so anyone with an alibi is cleared, and so is the place they were seen.
After all 10 clues, exactly one suspect, one place and one method are left. Make your accusation!

methods.name: Rolled up in a poster tube
Lowered out a window in a basket

clues.text: Mr. Patel was checking out books at the Front Desk the whole time. Twelve families saw him there.
The book cart was searched at the door. It held only picture books.
Ms. Greene was leading a book club in the Reading Room. Her group never let her leave.
Every backpack was checked at the exit. No atlas would even fit.
Officer Ruiz was locked inside the Rare Books Vault doing inventory. The vault log shows the door never opened.
The board-game boxes were all opened for Game Night. Nothing but game pieces inside.
Jada Brooks was reading to toddlers in the Children’s Corner. A dozen parents took videos.
The fake cover in the case is a decoy the library always uses. The real atlas was never swapped.
Mr. Fox was running a trivia contest from the Computer Lab. The livestream never shows him leaving.
All the windows are painted shut for the winter. Nothing went out in a basket.

ending: When the lights flickered, Professor Hale slipped into the Map Room, rolled the atlas into a poster tube labeled “Book Tour Posters,” and strolled toward the exit. Every alibi and every method you cleared pointed straight at him. Brilliant detective work!
